title: Seats
description: Give each member a seat so their personal GodarChat credit quota is clear.
intro: The free seat gives 500 credits once. Pro and Max give personal credits every month and, once those run out, use workspace credits up to the limit you set. API and key usage always comes from workspace credits.

summary.unassignedHint: They cannot send messages in GodarChat

buy.title: Buy seats
buy.description: With a seat subscription, new seats run to its period end and you pay only for the days left. Without one, this payment starts it.
buy.quantityHint: Bought seats stay in the organization's stock until you assign them.
buy.forMemberHint: Once paid, one seat goes to this member automatically.
buy.rules: Seats activate right after payment with this month's full quota. Seat reductions apply at the end of the period and are not refunded.
buy.noPaymentURL: The payment gateway returned no payment link. Try again.
buy.intervalHint: Every seat bought later follows this interval.
buy.startsSubscription: This payment starts your seat subscription. It does not renew on its own: renew it on this page during the 7 days before its period ends.
buy.pageDescription: Choose the seat type and quantity, then pay through the gateway.

requests.approved: Request approved; the member has the seat.
requests.empty: No upgrade requests yet. When a member runs out of credits, they can ask for a better seat in GodarChat, and the request shows up here.

orders.empty: No orders yet. Seat purchases and renewals are recorded here.

renewal.title: Seat renewal
renewal.description: Paid seats don't renew on their own. Pay for the renewal during the last 7 days of the period; otherwise paid seats are taken back from members.
renewal.dueDescription: {seats, number} seats need payment for the next period ({amount}). Seats not renewed are taken from members when the current period ends.
renewal.keepHint: You hold {held, number} seats; {assigned, number} are assigned to members.

settings.title: Seat settings
settings.description: Let members request upgrades, and cap how much organization credit Pro and Max members may use each month.
settings.requestsDescription: Members who run out of credits see a request-upgrade button in GodarChat.
settings.proLimit: Monthly Pro limit on organization credits
settings.maxLimit: Monthly Max limit on organization credits
settings.limitDescription: After their personal credits run out. Empty means no limit.
settings.limitInvalid: Enter a positive number with at most two decimals.

payment.successDescription: The seats were added to the organization's stock.
payment.failedDescription: Nothing was charged, or it will be refunded. Try again.

errors.title: Error
errors.invalid_seat_type: That seat type is not valid.
errors.seat_interval_not_supported: Seats can be bought for monthly or yearly subscriptions only.
errors.seat_unchanged: The member already has this seat.
errors.seat_back_to_free: A paid seat cannot go back to free.
errors.free_seat_used: This member already used their free seat.
errors.free_seats_full: All free seats are taken. Buy a paid seat for more members.
errors.seat_purchase_required: No seat of this type is available.
errors.no_pending_seat_change: This member has no scheduled change.
errors.invalid_seat_renewal: You cannot renew more seats than you hold.
errors.invalid_seat_pool_limit: The limit must be a positive number with at most two decimals.
errors.seat_interval_locked: New seats follow the billing interval of your seat subscription.
